node.statement: After the amendment of node 1, A>0 and Lambda>0 are explicit hypotheses. Hence the negative-A counterexample is outside the theorem domain, and node 1.2 validly gives (1-A*l_chi)/Lambda <= sum_{Q in F}|d_Q|. The permitted signed-variation ledger gives sum_{Q in F}|d_Q| <= a^+(F)+b^+(F)+nu(a)+nu(b). Transitivity and subtraction of nu(a)+nu(b) yield exactly a^+(F)+b^+(F) >= (1-A*l_chi)/Lambda-nu(a)-nu(b).
